system.description:
GENERAL GYMNAST

You launch into motion and convert it into raw kinetic power.

Prerequisites Acrobatics 6 ranks, Athletics 3 ranks

You may use your Acrobatics skill to make High Jump and Long Jump checks instead of the Athletics skill.

Automated: High Jump and Long Jump are offered from your Acrobatics as well as Athletics, with the same DCs, distances and trade-offs. A General feat: taken with a General feat pick, by a character who has the Gymnast archetype.
